scientific.integrity: The proof uses the exact primitive-ray relation printed in the initiating paper and the standard toric wall-intersection formula. The relevant maximal cones are confirmed in the paper's final-fan proposition; no numerical approximation is used.
limitations: Only non-nefness of the anticanonical divisor is established; the full Mori and nef cones are not determined.
No claim is made for all Demazure models or for the lower-dimensional constructions.
The result is a geometric property of the toric model defined by the final fan.

title: The \(A_4\) Demazure model is not weak Fano
